name: minimoon_ui_showcase
devtoolsChecks: Forms Project name belongs to the real native Form: short text blocks submission, busy disables repeat submits, and public httpbingo.org/post returns typed echo only (not persistent storage); Reset and unload reject late replies
All six category pages open and the 64 component headings are present
Every page switches light/dark themes and LTR/RTL direction without resetting component state
Foundation button disabled state, native label association, avatar fallback and semantic status presentation
Overlays open, nest, position inside viewport, dismiss correctly and retain controlled dialog state over hide/show
Context Menu long press and explicit tap both work; tooltip and Hover Card have touch access
Forms native input and textarea IME/paste/confirm, field errors, OTP completion and form submission
Checkbox, Radio Group, Switch, native/custom Select and Toggle Group respect disabled options
Slider single/native and multiple/custom thumbs preserve step and minimum gap; vertical and RTL touch cancellation work
Calendar single/multiple/range selection, disabled dates, today marker, hidden outside days and month boundaries; Date Picker presets, live label and dismissal
Command/Combobox filter choices; Data Table numeric sorts, column visibility, filters, selects and paginates without losing row identity; native Table colspan/rowspan geometry
Chart custom content, dot/line/dashed indicators, legend and tooltip presentation do not assume a browser chart engine
Carousel swipe, Resizable touch bounds/cancel, Scroll Area, Sidebar, navigation and attachment actions
Message Scroller follows only at end and preserves reading position when older messages are prepended
Toast and Sonner actions, dismissals, queue expiry and hide/show pause semantics
Every page unloads cleanly without stale measurement, timer, event or state delivery
